source_evidence: Player exact 'negotiate the price' authorizes bargaining only, not order/payment. Mara provides meaningful Help; Cirren Guidance separately. Before actual RNG declared each independent maker's tiers total<15/15–19/20–24/25+: Quill450/435/420/390gp, Needles420/405/390/360gp, deposits one-third. Quill ADV faces2,14 +7 Persuasion incl Luckstone +Guidance3=24, agreed price420gp deposit140 balance280. Needles ADV faces3,18 +7+Guidance4=29, agreed price360gp deposit120 balance240. Total780gp vs870gp, savings90gp. Makers retain separate 28-day estimated lead times from accepted order and deposit. No purchase, hold, cash transfer, materials committed or production begun. No new V speech or limited use. Serpent Dart remains unresolved. D325~16:00 Orsaven, after ordinary city visits with V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar; own coach and four horses remain securely at Copper Hart. V chose visit established friends/contacts and follow up three specific enchanted equipment inquiries. Morning Pellin Arkwright at Exchange greets returning party warmly, recognizes prior commercial relationships and refers existing estate business to empowered stewards rather than assuming new contracts, no new payment/market commitment. At Keepers' receiving house Maud Rennick visits/greets party, confirms from own personal observation the four workers rescued D201 have recovered and resumed ordinary work; one is reluctant to take underground/quarry jobs again. No additional commission or new proof about burial hillside, Keepers' separate review remains open pending their actual report; no claimed link to Graven. Sabine Okoro at Concord of Factors receives friendly visit and respects Tobin's confidential correspondence; no further letter, address, consent to meet or personal disclosure. Afternoon actual visits Breakwater Smithy, Lark Street Letter Writer and Two Spindles Clothiers, following Day216 inquiries. Breakwater still cannot secure an available qualified renewable-poison specialist: actual independent supplier follow-up d20 3+trade3=6 vs predeclared DC12, new network opportunity after elapsed109days, not replay of earlier failed check; no quote, ready item, order, fee, reservation or permanently closed lead. Smith can keep looking or V may seek other qualified suppliers; no additional commission accepted. At Lark Street, known qualified quillwright has reviewed previously provided exact design, confirms current bench/material availability and one commission slot; offers one Hadiya's Handy Quill (Saddlebag Book Two p97, uncommon attunement) for original450gp, now negotiated420gp, 140gp deposit and 280gp upon completed delivery, estimated 28 campaign days from accepted order, not current finished stock. At Two Spindles known specialist has reviewed paired design, confirms one commission slot and materials; offers one set Weaving Wasp Needles (Saddlebag Book Two p187, uncommon) for original420gp, now negotiated360gp, 120gp deposit and 240gp upon completed delivery, estimated 28 campaign days from accepted order, no finished stock. Exact terms are newly established in-world quotes not historical prices or guaranteed completion; acceptance/lead time begins only when V agrees and pays, no expiry/hold or cash taken. Separate makers; no duplicated existing stock or automatic sword enchantment, physical darts, normal source effects and attunement. No major purchase or further quest chosen. V has negotiated both maker-specific quotes; combined780gp, deposit260gp, remaining520gp on completed delivery. No accepted order, hold, deposit, purchase or production start. Await explicit acceptance of either/both or other choice; 28 campaign days begin only after actual order acceptance and deposit. V purse2311gp8sp6cp; rations21/feed28; LR5/6, no D325 overnight or new inn fee. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 +1 Shield equipped old shield retained, HD6/6 slots4/2/3 CD2/2 boots; Fenar59/59 AC16 breastplate and Insignia equipped HD6/6 Rage3/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, natural attacks +9, greataxe unchanged. All party/evidence/letter custody unchanged. Crown letter undelivered; frontier commission300+1300 and Coris300/800 contingent; Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. Dice delegated until stop.
